scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.check: npm run check -w server && npm run check -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.format: npm run format -w server && npm run format -w client
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check -w server && npm run format:check -w client
